actual_request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE original full-body transparent game walking sprite, character 10_crimson_spear_girl, frame W10 of16. Native at least1024x1024. Image1 is edit target and exact west/left-facing proportion reference. Image2 is original character identity ONLY. Image3 is confirmed MAIN STYLE: clean bright rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, no interface copied.
Change ONLY the actual legs and tiny natural cloth response to this gait phase: Keep LEFTMOST leading boot planted flat and stationary, knee flexing just slightly with weight acceptance. Keep original leg connections and foreground trailing thigh overlap unchanged. On the RIGHTMOST trailing boot only, raise the heel another 10 pixels while keeping its toe in contact at the same location. Rightmost near leg is about to lift off; leftmost far leg is bearing weight.
Lock Image1 face, two buns and long tails, torso, two hands and original left-high/right-low spear grip, red/ivory/gold costume and boots, exact full weapon, head/body proportions, subject scale and framing. No whole-character translation, mirroring, image deformation, running, jumping, high knees, extra limbs or crossed ankles. Keep calm short stride and at least one support foot. Entire hair, spear tip/butt and feet inside margins. Actual transparent alpha, no background/floor/shadow/checkerboard/text. Highest visual finish.

completionTimeEvidence: Only filled if present in actual result; archive observation is separate.
